Autopilot Firmware
Update flight controller firmware, select the active autopilot, and start/stop ArduPilot (if using Navigator or SITL).
Autopilot Parameters
View and modify vehicle parameters.
Log Browser
Allow browsing the Telemetry (.tlog) and Binary (.bin) logs generated by your vehicle. Bin logs are currently only supported for Navigator boards.
Network Test
Test link speed between topside computer and your vehicle.
Ping Sonar Devices
Manage detected Ping family sonar devices, connected to either your Onboard Computer or its local network.
System Information
Detailed system status information, CPU, memory, disk, and ethernet status.
Vehicle Setup
Vehicle and Peripherals setup. Includes sensor calibrations and Motors/Peripherals mapping.
Video Streams
Manage your video devices and video streams.
